semiconductor_relevance: High — UNISERS Ltd. provides critical contamination control solutions that enhance the detection and analysis of impurities in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: UNISERS Ltd. offers advanced contamination control solutions for the semiconductor industry, utilizing a unique vacuum-based plasma coating technology. This technology significantly improves the detection of contaminants on silicon wafers, aiding manufacturers in reducing waste and saving costs.
capabilities: Vacuum-based plasma coating technology for contamination detection
Detection of contaminants down to 10 nanometers
Optical microscope integration for impurity identification
SEPS technology for advanced particle size and type determination
